v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.la: Et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
r.en: And my mouth shall declare thy praise.

full.en: Come * Let us glorify the Lord.

la: Iubilémus Deo, salutári nostro: præoccupémus fáciem eius in confessióne, et in psalmis iubilémus ei.
Quóniam Deus magnus Dóminus, et Rex magnus super omnes deos, quóniam non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: quia in manu eius sunt omnes fines terræ, et altitúdines móntium ipse cónspicit.

Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus, Deus noster; nos autem pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius.
Hódie, si vocem eius audiéritis, nolíte obduráre corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatióne secúndum diem tentatiónis in desérto: ubi tentavérunt me patres vestri, probavérunt et vidérunt ópera mea.
Quadragínta annis próximus fui generatióni huic, et dixi: Semper hi errant corde, ipsi vero non cognovérunt vias meas: quibus iurávi in ira mea: Si introíbunt in réquiem meam.
en: Let us joyfully sing to God our saviour. Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.
For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods. For the Lord will not cast off his people: for in his hand are all the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are his.

For the sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land. Come let us adore and fall down: and weep before the Lord that made us: For he is the Lord our God: and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand.

Today if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts: As in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness: where your fathers tempted me, they proved me, and saw my works.
Forty years long was I offended with that generation, and I said: These always err in heart. And these men have not known my ways: so I swore in my wrath that they shall not enter into my rest.

v.en: Sing to the Lord, O ye his saints.

r.en: And give praise to the memory of his holiness.

text.la: Dóminus de cælo * prospéxit super fílios hóminum.
text.en: The Lord hath looked down from heaven * upon the children of men.

text.la: Qui operátur iustítiam * requiéscet in monte sancto tuo, Dómine.
text.en: He who worketh justice * may rest on thy holy mountain, O Lord.

text.la: Inclína, Dómine, * aurem tuam mihi, et exáudi verba mea.
text.en: O Lord, incline * thy ear to me, and hear my voice, my Lord.

text.la: Retríbuet mihi Dóminus * secúndum iustítiam meam.
text.en: The Lord will reward me * according to my justice.

text.la: Exáudiat te * Dóminus in die tribulatiónis. ‡
text.en: May the Lord hear * thee in the day of tribulation. ‡

text.la: Dómine, * in virtúte tua lætábitur rex. ‡
text.en: The king rejoices * in Thy strength, O Lord. ‡

text.la: Exaltábo te, * Dómine, quóniam suscepísti me. ‡
text.en: I will extol thee, * O Lord, for thou hast upheld me. ‡

text.la: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
text.en: Our Father is said silently until And lead us not into temptation:.

text.la: Exáudi, Dómine Iesu Christe, preces servórum tuórum, et miserére nobis: Qui cum Patre et Spíritu Sancto vivis et regnas in sǽcula sæculórum.
text.en: O Lord Jesus Christ, graciously hear the prayers of Thy servants, and have mercy upon us, Who livest and reignest with the Father, and the Holy Ghost, ever world without end.

benedictio.la: Benedictióne perpétua benedícat nos Pater ætérnus.
benedictio.en: May the Eternal Father bless us with an eternal blessing.

source.en: Lesson from the second book of Machabees

text.la: 1 Invenítur autem in descriptiónibus Ieremíæ prophétæ, quod iussit eos ignem accípere qui transmigrábant, ut significátum est, et ut mandávit transmigrátis, 2 Et dedit illis legem, ne oblivisceréntur præcépta Dómini, et ut non exerrárent méntibus, vidéntes simulácra áurea et argéntea, et ornaménta eórum; 3 Et ália huiúsmodi dicens, hortabátur ne legem amovérent a corde suo.
text.en: 1 Now it is found in the descriptions of Jeremias the prophet, that he commanded them that went into captivity, to take the fire, as it hath been signified, and how he gave charge to them that were carried away into captivity. 2 And how he gave them the law that they should not forget the commandments of the Lord, and that they should not err in their minds, seeing the idols of gold, and silver, and the ornaments of them. 3 And with other such like speeches, he exhorted them that they would not remove the law from their heart.

body.la: Dixit Iudas Simóni fratri suo: Elige tibi viros et vade, líbera fratres tuos in Galilǽam; ego autem et Iónathas frater tuus íbimus in Galaadítim:
body.en: Judas said unto Simon his brother: Choose thee out men, and go, and deliver thy brethren that are in Galilee and I, and Jonathan thy brother, will go into the country of Galaad.

refrain.la: Sicut fúerit volúntas in cælo, sic fiat.
refrain.en: As the Will is in heaven, so let it be.

verse.la: Accingímini, fílii poténtes, et estóte paráti: quóniam mélius est nobis, mori in bello, quam vidére mala gentis nostræ et sanctórum.
verse.en: Arm yourselves, ye valiant men, and be in readiness for it is better for us to die in battle, than to behold the calamities of our people, and our sanctuary.

benedictio.la: Unigénitus Dei Fílius nos benedícere et adiuváre dignétur.
benedictio.en: May the Son, the Sole-begotten, mercifully bless and keep us.

text.la: 4 Erat autem in ipsa scriptúra, quómodo tabernáculum et arcam iussit prophéta, divíno respónso ad se facto, comitári secum, úsquequo éxiit in montem, in quo Móyses ascéndit, et vidit Dei hereditátem. 5 Et véniens ibi Ieremías, invénit locum spelúncæ: et tabernáculum, et arcam, et altáre incénsi íntulit illuc, et óstium obstrúxit. 6 Et accessérunt quidam simul, qui sequebántur, ut notárent sibi locum: et non potuérunt inveníre.
text.en: 4 It was also contained in the same writing, how the prophet, being warned by God, commanded that the tabernacle and the ark should accompany him, till he came forth to the mountain where Moses went up, and saw the inheritance of God. 5 And when Jeremias came thither he found a hollow cave: and he carried in thither the tabernacle, and the ark, and the altar of incense, and so stopped the door. 6 Then some of them that followed him, came up to mark the place: but they could not find it.

body.la: Ornavérunt fáciem templi corónis áureis, et dedicavérunt altáre Dómino:
body.en: They decked the fore-front of the Temple with crowns of gold, and dedicated the Altar unto the Lord.

refrain.la: Et facta est lætítia magna in pópulo.
refrain.en: And there was very great gladness among the people.

verse.la: In hymnis et confessiónibus benedicébant Dóminum.
verse.en: They praised the Lord with Psalms and thanksgiving.

benedictio.la: Spíritus Sancti grátia illúminet sensus et corda nostra.
benedictio.en: May the grace of the Holy Spirit enlighten all our hearts and minds.

text.la: 7 Ut autem cognóvit Ieremías, culpans illos dixit: quod ignótus erit locus, donec cóngreget Deus congregatiónem pópuli, et propítius fiat; 8 Et tunc Dóminus osténdet hæc, et apparébit maiéstas Dómini, et nubes erit, sicut et Móysi manifestabátur, et sicut, cum Sálomon pétiit ut locus sanctificarétur magno Deo, manifestábat hæc; 9 Magnífice étenim sapiéntiam tractábat: et ut sapiéntiam habens, óbtulit sacrifícium dedicatiónis et consummatiónis templi.
text.en: 7 And when Jeremias perceived it, he blamed them, saying: The place shall be unknown, till God gather together the congregation of the people, and receive them to mercy. 8 And then the Lord will shew these things, and the majesty of the Lord shall appear, and there shall be a cloud as it was also shewed to Moses, and he shewed it when Solomon prayed that the place might be sanctified to the great God. 9 For he treated wisdom in a magnificent manner: and like a wise man, he offered the sacrifice of the dedication, and of the finishing of the temple.

body.la: In hymnis et confessiónibus benedicébant Dóminum,
body.en: They praised the Lord with psalms and thanksgiving

refrain.la: Qui magna fecit in Israël, et victóriam dedit illis Dóminus omnípotens.
refrain.en: Who had done so great things in Israel, and given them the victory the Lord Almighty.

verse.la: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
verse.en: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

text.la: Reliqua omittuntur, nisi Laudes separandæ sint.
text.en: Skip the rest, unless praying Lauds separately.

text.la: Absólve, quǽsumus, Dómine, tuórum delícta populórum: ut a peccatórum néxibus, quæ pro nostra fragilitáte contráximus, tua benignitáte liberémur.
text.en: O Lord, we beseech thee, absolve thy people from their offences, that through thy bountiful goodness we may all be delivered from the bands of those sins, which by our frailty we have committed.

office.title: Feria Secunda infra Hebd XXIII post Octavam Pentecostes IV. Octobris
